# Plan: cross-initiative-conflicts

Goal: Widen collision detection past the initiative boundary without paying O(total history) on the hook path: two sessions on DIFFERENT initiatives editing one file are invisible today (the hook folds one slug; doctor loops slugs but detects per-slug). Gate the hot path on a git-proof warm-log signal — the true last-append time read from each log's TAIL, never mtime — and leave sofar doctor ungated so the exhaustive answer always exists. Measured budget: shim is 63-67ms of speed T2's 100ms; fold-all-30 costs +15.8ms and is O(history), gated costs ~+1.7ms and is O(concurrent activity).

Progress: 4/5 tasks done (80%)
